purpose: Validation-only grouped cross-validation selection and deployable uncertainty intervals
claim_boundary: No test labels may be loaded, inspected, scored, or used for calibration selection, fitting, or conformal quantiles.

grouped_cross_validation.group_id: cluster from the frozen MMseqs homology split manifest
grouped_cross_validation.fit_scope: fit each candidate on validation-fold training groups and score held-out validation groups
grouped_cross_validation.refit_scope: refit the selected candidate on all validation outputs

selection.tie_rule: Within NLL tolerance compare CRPS; within both tolerances retain the earlier simpler candidate.

variants: absolute residual normalized by selected calibrated standard deviation
conformal_intervals.tie_policy: higher order statistic with boundary ties covered

artifact.predict_output: calibrated standard deviation plus normalized and unnormalized 90/95 conformal bounds
